insurance_required.quote: Every person applying for a license to conduct the business of a pawnbroker shall first effect an insurance policy against fire for $50,000 for the protection of goods, pawned or pledged.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The licenses shall designate the address in which the person or company shall carry on the business. No person or company shall engage in or carry on the business of pawnbroker, secondhand dealer or scrap metal processor in any other building than the one designated in the license.

citations.cite: § 2317. Unlicensed pawnbrokers, secondhand dealers or scrap metal processors.

definition_quote.value: "Secondhand dealer" means any person, company, corporation, or member or members of a partnership or firm whose storefront business includes any volume of selling or receiving previously owned, used, rented or leased tangible personal property excluding motor vehicles.
definition_quote.quote: "Secondhand dealer" means any person, company, corporation, or member or members of a partnership or firm whose storefront business includes any volume of selling or receiving previously owned, used, rented or leased tangible personal property excluding motor vehicles.

transaction_record_format.quote: Every pawnbroker and secondhand dealer shall create a record and provide information regarding merchandise acquired via an electronic format to be determined by the Secretary of Safety and Homeland Security.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: The information provided on the forms under this section shall be stored and maintained by the pawnbroker, secondhand dealer, or scrap metal processor for a period of 1 year and shall be provided to police immediately upon request.

electronic_reporting_to_law_enforcement_.quote: shall be submitted electronically by the close of business the next business day, in a format to be determined by the Secretary of the Department of Safety and Homeland Security, to the law-enforcement agency having primary jurisdiction over the area in which the business is located.

reporting_frequency.quote: shall be submitted electronically by the close of business the next business day

seller_photo_required.quote: Pawnbrokers and secondhand dealers shall collect a photograph of the seller and all information pertaining to the seller, required on the electronic form, for every transaction regardless of value.

seller_thumbprint_required.quote: Automated kiosks shall collect a right thumbprint image of the seller and all information pertaining to the seller including photograph and valid government issued identification, required on the electronic form, for every transaction regardless of value.

seller_vehicle_info_required.quote: The registration plate number, make, and model of the vehicle used in the delivery of scrap metal or other items.

seller_ownership_statement_required.quote: A signed statement from the individual receiving consideration for the purchase stating that the individual is the rightful owner of the catalytic converter or is authorized to sell the catalytic converter.

holding_period_days.quote: Every pawnbroker and secondhand dealer subject to this chapter must keep for a period of 18 days, including weekends and holidays, subject to inspection by any police officer of Delaware, all goods, wares and merchandise purchased or received from any person before selling, shipping or otherwise disposing of the same.

holding_period_varies_by_material.quote: Scrap metal processors must hold platinum, gold and silver articles for 18 days.

law_enforcement_hold_order_authority.quote: Law-enforcement officers may require that an item be held for an additional 30 days beyond the requirements of subsection (a) of this section if they know or have reason to believe that the property is missing or stolen.

pawnbroker_interest_rate_cap.quote: No person conducting the business of a pawnbroker shall ask, demand or receive a greater rate of interest than 30 percent per month on any loans secured by pledge of personal property.
